name: 93960 · Soledad, CA
findings: ZIP 93960 (Soledad) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93960 (Soledad) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93960 (Soledad) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 15% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
